text: Applicant should meet one of the following requirements:TCM Bachelor's Degree with a good command of English;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and Bearer of TCM or Acupuncturist License in his home country;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, has been trained for TCM or Acupuncture, and been practicing them over 2 years;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and has completed the designated courses.
